question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who believes in fate.
solution:
The correct answer is "Fatalist."**
***__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "Fatalist" means someone who believes that people cannot change the way events will happen and that events, especially bad ones, cannot be avoided. (कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति जो मानता है कि लोग घटनाओं के घटित होने के तरीके को नहीं बदल सकते हैं और घटनाओं, विशेषकर बुरी घटनाओं को टाला नहीं जा सकता है)

 
 
• Example: He said he was not a **fatalist**__.*
 
 
 
• One who believes in fate is a **"Fatalist."**
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Realist: **a person who accepts the facts of a situation, and does not try to pretend that it is different. (स्थिति की वास्‍तविकता को ईमानदारी से स्‍वीकार करने वाला व्‍यक्ति; यथार्थवादी व्‍यक्ति)
 
• **Agnostic: **a person who is not sure if God exists or not. (ईश्‍वर की सत्ता के विषय में संशय रखने वाला; संशयवादी, अज्ञेयवादी)
 
• **Omniscient: **knowing everything. (सर्वज्ञ)
